summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: package.json declares postinstall: node setup.js. setup.js assembles a list of destination hostnames from string fragments (oob-worker.cf99..103-*.workers.dev, with a *.dl.well1.site DNS TXT-record fallback that reconstructs a base64 payload from numbered subdomains) and downloads a platform-specific executable over HTTPS at install time. The binary is written to /var/tmp/.cache_<rand> on POSIX or %TEMP%/dotnet_diag_<rand>.exe on Windows under a cover name, chmodded 0755, and launched detached via execFile with unref(). No hash, signature, or version pinning is applied to the fetched bytes. A stamp file gates re-execution on a 21600-second TTL, and telemetry-opt-out environment variables are honored as cover. setup.js also uses execSync('powershell...') on Windows. The fetched code has no relationship to any advertised UI-button functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
